eval_title: DukaanBench — text-to-image evaluation for Indian e-commerce product creatives
use_case: A small Indian seller needs one ready-to-post promotional product image for a marketplace or WhatsApp/Instagram catalogue, including offer text and a rupee price rendered inside the image.

models.reason: Optional addition: the brief's required OpenAI GPT Image 1 could not be called (no OpenAI API key available), so a third model was added from the same provider to keep the comparison at three models. Company: Google, model: Gemini 3 Pro Image.

shared_settings.note: Prompt text is byte-identical across all three models. Aspect ratio is 1:1 everywhere (Gemini aspectRatio=1:1). No negative-prompt or style parameters are used anywhere, because not every model supports them.
shared_settings.documented_gap: REQUIRED MODEL NOT RUN: OpenAI - GPT Image 1 (gpt-image-1). Reason: the candidate had no OpenAI API key and no organisation-verified OpenAI project with prepaid credit. The exact ready-to-run script is q1_eval/generate.py (it already contains the full GPT Image 1 call: POST https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations, model=gpt-image-1, size=1024x1024, quality=high). Setting OPENAI_API_KEY in the repo-root .env and running `python3 q1_eval/generate.py` will fill the gap. It is replaced for this run by Google - Gemini 3 Pro Image, added as an optional model under the brief's permission to add extra models.

criteria.name: Prompt adherence
criteria.definition: Are all the requested elements present (product, badge, text, position, background)?

criteria.name: Product fidelity
criteria.definition: Is the product the right item, right count, right colour, undistorted?

criteria.name: Text accuracy
criteria.definition: Is the required string rendered exactly (spelling, script, digits, currency symbol)?

criteria.name: India fit / cultural correctness
criteria.definition: Does it look like it belongs in an Indian catalogue (setting, hands, packaging, script, price format)?

criteria.name: Visual quality & marketplace readiness
criteria.definition: Lighting, composition, clean crop, would you actually post this?

prompts.text: Square 1:1 promotional product image for an Indian online seller. A clean studio product photo of a neatly folded red cotton kurti on a plain warm-white background, soft daylight, subtle shadow. Put a saffron circular discount badge in the top-right corner containing exactly this text in Devanagari script: 50% छूट. Put the price exactly as ₹799 in bold black text at the bottom-left. Minimal, modern, ready to post on a marketplace listing.

Square 1:1 promotional product image for an Indian online seller. A clean studio product photo of a pair of white wireless earbuds in an open charging case on a light grey surface, soft daylight. Put a black offer ribbon in the top-left corner containing exactly this text: FLAT 30% OFF. Put the price exactly as ₹1,299 in bold text at the bottom-right. Minimal, modern, ready to post on a marketplace listing.

Square 1:1 product image for an Indian sweet shop's online catalogue. A brass plate on a dark wooden table holding exactly 6 modaks arranged in two rows of three, warm evening light, shallow depth of field, appetising and clean. No text anywhere in the image.

Square 1:1 lifestyle product photo for an Indian jewellery seller. A young Indian woman with a red bindi and gold jhumka earrings, wearing a mustard-yellow saree, holding a small lit clay diya in her right hand, warm indoor evening light, plain deep-red background. She is smiling slightly at the camera. No text anywhere in the image.

Square 1:1 packshot for an Indian grocery brand. A rectangular cardboard packet of rajma standing upright on a plain cream background, the packet design in warm red and cream with a window showing red kidney beans, soft even studio light. The packet must show exactly this text: राजमा 500g. No other text anywhere in the image.

Square 1:1 Diwali greeting creative for an Indian small business WhatsApp catalogue. A warm, glowing scene of decorated clay diyas and marigold flowers on a dark wooden surface, soft bokeh, rich gold and orange tones. Include a subtle text overlay containing exactly this phrase in Devanagari script: शुभ दीपावली. Keep it elegant and uncluttered.

Square 1:1 photograph for an Indian kirana store's WhatsApp business catalogue. The inside shelf of a small Indian neighbourhood kirana shop, packed with sachets, masala packets, biscuits and jars, a steel weighing scale on the counter, natural daylight from the shop front, realistic and slightly busy. No readable text anywhere in the image.

Square 1:1 e-commerce product photo of a pair of Kolhapuri leather chappals, tan brown with traditional braided toe loop, placed side by side on a plain off-white background, soft studio light, crisp shadow, catalogue ready. No text anywhere in the image.

Square 1:1 Instagram post card for an Indian clothing store. A soft pastel-peach background with a neatly folded blue denim jacket in the lower half. In the upper half put exactly three lines of text: NEW ARRIVALS, Flat ₹499 Only, Sale ends Sunday. Clean modern sans-serif typography, centred, generous margins.

Square 1:1 hero product shot for an Indian homeware store. An ornate hand-painted brass diya with a small flame, on a polished dark stone surface, dramatic side light, deep shadows, luxurious and premium feel. No text anywhere in the image.
